scenarios.title: A｜询问什么意思
scenarios.setting: 约会时，对方评价玩家的穿着：“You’d look better if you dressed a little more feminine.”

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: What do you mean by that?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you mean by that?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What exactly do you mean by “more feminine”?

feedback.naturalExpression: What exactly do you mean by “more feminine”?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not sure I understand what you’re trying to say.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure I understand what you’re trying to say.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Are you saying you don’t like the way I dress?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you saying you don’t like the way I dress?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What do you want to mean?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you mean by that?
feedback.explanation: 应为 What do you mean?

turns.text: I don’t know. I just think you’d look better in something more… elegant.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Why do you think I need to dress differently?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why do you think I need to dress differently?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Is that something that’s actually important to you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that something that’s actually important to you?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: So you’d prefer me to change the way I dress?

feedback.naturalExpression: So you’d prefer me to change the way I dress?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m asking because that comment came across a little strangely.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m asking because that comment came across a little strangely.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: It was just an opinion. I wasn’t trying to insult you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. I wanted to understand what you meant before reacting.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I wanted to understand what you meant before reacting.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Fair enough. But it did make me a little uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: Fair enough. But it did make me a little uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜明确表达不舒服
scenarios.setting: 在“对方说了让自己不舒服的话”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“明确表达不舒服”。

turns.text: Come on, I was just giving you a suggestion.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know, but that comment made me uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but that comment made me uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’d rather you didn’t make comments about how I should dress.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather you didn’t make comments about how I should dress.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You might not have meant anything by it, but it didn’t feel good to hear.

feedback.naturalExpression: You might not have meant anything by it, but it didn’t feel good to hear.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m comfortable with how I look, and I don’t want to feel like I need to change that for you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m comfortable with how I look, and I don’t want to feel like I need to change that for you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: You’re taking it way too seriously. I was joking.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Maybe you meant it as a joke, but I didn’t find it funny.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe you meant it as a joke, but I didn’t find it funny.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m telling you how it made me feel. I’d like you to respect that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m telling you how it made me feel. I’d like you to respect that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Whether it was a joke or not, I’m asking you not to say things like that to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Whether it was a joke or not, I’m asking you not to say things like that to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You don’t have to agree that it was offensive, but you do need to respect my boundary.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t have to agree that it was offensive, but you do need to respect my boundary.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Okay. I didn’t realize it bothered you that much.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Thanks. I just wanted to be clear about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I just wanted to be clear about it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I appreciate you listening.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate you listening.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜对方拒绝道歉
scenarios.setting: 在“对方说了让自己不舒服的话”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方拒绝道歉”。

turns.text: I’m not apologizing for having an opinion.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m not asking you to apologize for having an opinion. I’m telling you that the way you expressed it hurt me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not asking you to apologize for having an opinion. I’m telling you that the way you expressed it hurt me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You don’t have to agree with me, but dismissing how I feel isn’t okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t have to agree with me, but dismissing how I feel isn’t okay.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If I tell you something makes me uncomfortable, I expect you to take that seriously.

feedback.naturalExpression: If I tell you something makes me uncomfortable, I expect you to take that seriously.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think this conversation is going anywhere if you’re not willing to listen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think this conversation is going anywhere if you’re not willing to listen.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I think you’re being way too sensitive.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Calling me sensitive doesn’t address what I’m saying.

feedback.naturalExpression: Calling me sensitive doesn’t address what I’m saying.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You’re allowed to think that. I’m still allowed to have boundaries.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re allowed to think that. I’m still allowed to have boundaries.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: This is exactly the kind of response I’m not comfortable with.

feedback.naturalExpression: This is exactly the kind of response I’m not comfortable with.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t want to continue this conversation if you’re going to talk to me like that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to continue this conversation if you’re going to talk to me like that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I think I’m going to head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’m going to head home.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I think we should end the evening here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I think we should end the evening here.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think we’re going to resolve this tonight. I’m leaving.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think we’re going to resolve this tonight. I’m leaving.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
